mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the chest and lower body was worthwhile because it showed how the diaphragm separates the regions while the food pipe, nerves and vessels follow their own routes.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the urinary organs was clear but mostly a predictable named-slot action, with little decision-making involved.

surprise.text: The finished body showed that the same muscle needs both nerve signals and materials carried by blood; those systems are not just separate pieces.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the slots and goals explained where the pieces belonged, though that also made many choices straightforward.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter offered a new problem to figure out. Bringing the systems together was satisfying, but another round of mostly named-slot assembly would be less appealing.
